resolved.title: 视图 View
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Views[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

In SQL, a VIEW is a [b]virtual table[/b] that is based on the result-set of an SQL statement.

A view contains rows and columns, just like a real table. The fields in a view are fields from one or more real tables in the database.

Views allow us to:
- Structure data in a way that users or classes of users find natural or intuitive.
- Restrict access to the data in such a way that a user can see and (sometimes) modify exactly what they need and no more.
- Summarize data from various tables and use it to generate reports.

[s0l0!-header][b]To create a view:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="sql" ][b]CREATE VIEW [/b]view_name [b]AS[/b]
SELECT column_name(s)
FROM table_name
WHERE condition;[/code]
[note]The SELECT query can be as complex as you need it to be. It can contain multiple JOINS and other commands.[/note]

resolved.problem_statement_md:
你正在管理一个社交网站的用户数据库。
下面是用户表**users**的详细信息:

![](/content/assets/661a5136a17adf8c96e5.jpeg)

写一个查询，创建一个视图，只显示`acc_id`和`status`列，然后查询该视图。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Views[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You manage a database of social network users.
Here is the [b]users[/b] table with details:  [img id="4528" width="100%"] 
Write a query to create a view to show only 'acc_id' and 'status' columns and then show that view.
[note]Don't forget to name the view and use the [b]AS[/b] keyword.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 不要忘记给视图命名，并使用**AS**关键字。

code_templates.solution_code:
CREATE VIEW List AS
SELECT acc_id, status
FROM users;
SELECT * FROM List

resolved.title: 更新视图
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Updating a View[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You can update a view by using the following syntax:[code format="sql" ][b]CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW[/b] view_name [b]AS[/b]
SELECT column_name(s)
FROM table_name
WHERE condition;[/code]
The example below updates our [b]List [/b]view to select also the LastName: [code format="sql" codeId="3085"]CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW List AS
SELECT FirstName, LastName, Salary
FROM  Employees;[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2857" width="100%"]
You can delete a view with the DROP VIEW command. [code format="sql" ][b]DROP VIEW[/b] List;[/code]
[note]It is sometimes easier to drop a table and recreate it instead of using the ALTER TABLE statement to change the table’s definition.[/note]
